title: A World Based On Ratings #shorts #movie
transcript: In this world, your rating determines how you live. The higher it is, the more opportunities and respect you get. But if you get rated poorly, your living conditions become terrible. Lacy saw two highly rated people sitting next to her at the restaurant and spent half of her monthly salary on a single cookie. She carefully took a bite out of it before instantly spitting it out and decorating her plate. As soon as she posted the picture online, her rating increased by a small amount. That day at work, a low-rated waiter offered her a drink in order to get his rating up. But after accepting it and rating him highly, her co-workers anonymously rated both her and the waiter one star just because she interacted with someone lower rated. She then went to rent a new apartment, but the secretary quickly explained that because her rating was under a 4.5, she would have to pay five times extra. Her rating therapist told her that if she took ratings from people with high scores, the rating would be multiplied. She started smiling at random people on the way, but ignored the waiter as he wasn't even allowed in the building. That day, her famous old friend invited Lacy to her wedding. All the top-rated people in the country would be there. As she was going to the airport, however, she accidentally laughed at a video, causing the taxi driver to instantly give her one star. She was 3 minutes late due to the traffic, but her ticket was already canceled and she received a 24-hour rating penalty prohibiting her from all transport. For causing a scene, every person around her rated her negatively, making the situation even worse. Her only hope was to catch a lift to the wedding, but people were scared of her and even rated her negatively just for having a low rating. Just then, a truck pulled up and offered her a lift. Even though the driver's rating was 1.4, Lacy reluctantly accepted and learned the truth about the system.
